name: Hyperresearch
summary: Agentic deep-research service that returns cited reports with every claim checked against its source.
description: Hyperresearch runs multi-step research across several AI search engines and 40+ data sources, then delivers a report with the source list and a claims table with quotes; sources are kept in a searchable vault. An Answers MCP and API are also offered. Priced per run: Light $9, Deep $49; no subscription (first Deep run free when adding a card).
